answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the crystal of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The timber is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the glacier. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
